definition_zh: 监禁；关押；徒刑；被囚禁的状态
definition_en: the state or act of being shut up in a prison, usually as a punishment
core_image: 一扇铁门从外面落锁，把一个人从街道上取走，只留下墙内一小块属于他的地面
scene: 法庭宣判后，法警把被告带离座位，走廊尽头的铁门关上，他将在窄小的牢房里度过许多年。 The judge imposed a long term of imprisonment on the man who had robbed the shop.
sceneCN: 这里指作为刑罚的关押，对应第 1 个义项：被判入狱服刑；句意为法官对抢劫商店的男子判处长期监禁。画面要点：法槌落下、被告被带走、铁门合拢。

pos.zh: 监禁；关押（不可数，指刑罚或状态）
刑期；服刑期间（可数，常与 years、life 等连用）

derivatives.zh: 监禁；关押（由表「进入」的前缀（拉丁语 in）加 prison 构成）→ 由「监狱」转为「使进入监狱」
被关押的；受禁锢的（加过去分词词尾，作形容词，表被动状态）→ 由「关押」转为「处在被关押之中的」
可判处监禁的（加形容词后缀（源自拉丁语，表「能被……」））→ 由「关押」转为「够得上被关押的」
使人如困牢笼的（加现在分词词尾，作形容词，表主动施加）→ 由「关进监狱」转为「把人在感觉上关住的」

senses.title: The penalty of being locked away
senses.definition: the punishment in which a person is confined in a prison for a period set by a court
senses.definitionCN: 由法庭确定期限、把人在监狱内关押起来的刑罚
senses.example: The judge imposed a long term of imprisonment on the man who had robbed the shop.
senses.exampleCN: 法官对抢劫商店的男子判处长期监禁。
senses.why: The noun adds -ment, 'act or state', to imprison, so it names the whole condition produced when the verb is carried out; the penalty sense is that condition viewed as a sentence.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词由 imprison 加名词后缀（表动作或状态）构成，指动词执行后造成的整个处境；把它看作一种判决，就是作为刑罚的关押。

senses.title: The condition of being confined
senses.definition: the lived state of a person who is kept inside walls and cannot leave
senses.definitionCN: 人被关在墙内、不能离开的那种生活状态
senses.example: Years of imprisonment had left him afraid of open spaces.
senses.exampleCN: 多年监禁使他对开阔的空间感到害怕。
senses.why: The same -ment can name a state rather than an event, so the word shifts from the sentence handed down to what the sentence feels like from inside.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词后缀也能指状态而非事件，词义于是从「宣判的那一下」转到「从里面感受到的判决」。

senses.title: A term served, viewed as time
senses.titleCN: 被当作一段时间来数的刑期
senses.definition: the period during which a person is held, treated as a span of time in someone's life
senses.definitionCN: 人被关押的那段时间，被当作某人生命中的一段来计量
senses.example: He wrote most of the novel during his imprisonment.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说的大部分是他在监禁期间写成的。
senses.why: Once the state has a beginning and an end, it can be counted; counting turns the condition into a term, and a term can be spent, served or survived.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这种处境有了开头和结尾，它就能被计数；计数把处境变成刑期，而刑期可以被度过、服完或熬过。

senses.title: Custody before any trial
senses.definition: confinement of a suspect while legal proceedings are still pending
senses.definitionCN: 在司法程序尚未结束期间对嫌疑人实施的关押
senses.example: Suspects may face months of imprisonment before any trial begins.
senses.exampleCN: 嫌疑人可能在审判开始之前被关押数月。
senses.why: If the verb only means to shut someone in, it need not wait for a verdict; custody is imprisonment before the penalty has been decided.
senses.whyCN: 如果动词的本义只是「把人关起来」，那就不必等判决；羁押是处罚尚未定下之前就已发生的监禁。

senses.title: Unlawful holding by captors
senses.titleCN: 被掳者实施的非法关押
senses.definition: confinement imposed by captors or authorities who have no legal right to hold the person
senses.definitionCN: 由无合法关押权的掳掠者或当局施加的关押
senses.example: The journalists described their imprisonment by the militia.
senses.exampleCN: 记者们描述了民兵对他们的关押。
senses.why: The word describes the physical fact of confinement and does not certify that the confinement is lawful, so it serves equally for a kidnapper's cellar.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描述的是关押这一物理事实，并不担保关押合法，因此同样适用于绑架者的地窖。

senses.title: Confinement of the mind
senses.definition: a figurative state in which a person feels trapped by circumstances, work or habit
senses.definitionCN: 人因处境、工作或习惯而感到被牢牢困住的比喻状态
senses.example: She felt her imprisonment in a job that allowed no creativity.
senses.exampleCN: 她感到自己被一份毫无创造空间的工作禁锢住了。
senses.why: The core image needs only walls and a lock; when the walls become rules or routines, the same noun describes a life with no exit.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象只需要墙与锁；当墙变成规矩或惯例，同一个名词就用来描述没有出口的生活。

senses.title: Mass detention of a group
senses.definition: the holding of many people together in camps or closed areas, often in wartime
senses.definitionCN: 把许多人集中关押在营地或封闭区域内，常发生在战时
senses.example: The museum records the imprisonment of thousands in the camps.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆记录了成千上万人在营地的关押。
senses.why: Because the noun has no singular subject built in, it can be used of a crowd as easily as of one man; scale changes, the walls do not.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词本身不限定只能指一个人，因此既可指一人也可指一群人；规模变了，墙还是那道墙。

senses.title: The act of putting someone away
senses.definition: the act of confining a person, considered as something done by an authority or a captor
senses.definitionCN: 把人关押起来这一动作，被视为某当局或掳掠者所做之事
senses.example: The imprisonment of the union leaders provoked protests across the city.
senses.exampleCN: 对工会领导人的关押在整座城市引发了抗议。
senses.why: The -ment noun can name the deed as well as its result; naming the deed lets speakers argue about who did it and whether it should have been done.
senses.whyCN: 带名词后缀的名词既能指结果，也能指行为本身；点出行为，人们才能争论是谁做的、该不该做。

intro.en: Imprisonment is English through and through in its building: in- 'into' plus prison plus -ment. Prison itself goes back through Old French to Latin prehensio 'a seizing', from prehendere 'to grasp', so the word is about capture before it is about architecture.
intro.cn: imprisonment 的构造完全是英语自身的：表「进入」的前缀加 prison 再加名词后缀。prison 经古法语上溯拉丁 prehensio「抓取」，源头是动词 prehendere「抓住」，所以这个词先说的是捕获，其次才是建筑。

items.en: Prehendere was an attested verb meaning to seize, grasp or take hold of a person or thing.
items.cn: prehendere 是文献中确有的动词，意为抓住、握取或捕获人或物。

items.en: The noun of action prehensio 'a seizing, a capture' supplied the sense of a person taken and held; the later sense of a place for holding them grew from this.
items.cn: 动作名词 prehensio「抓取、捕获」提供了「人被捉住并扣留」这一层意思；后来「扣留人的场所」之义即由此生长出来。

items.en: Old French shortened the Latin noun into prison, which meant both the act of holding and the place of confinement; the date of this reduction is uncertain.
items.cn: 古法语把这一拉丁名词缩短为 prison，兼指扣留的行为与关押的场所；这一缩略发生的年代不确定。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the thirteenth century, at first for the place and the state of being held there.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入该词，最初指场所以及被关在其中的状态。

items.en: The verb was formed inside English by adding in- 'into' to the noun, so that it means literally to put someone into a prison.
items.cn: 动词是在英语内部构成的，给名词加上表「进入」的前缀，字面即「把某人放进监狱」。

items.en: Adding -ment, the Latin-derived suffix for an act or its result, produced the noun; its first records are medieval and the exact date is uncertain.
items.cn: 再加上源自拉丁、表示动作或其结果的名词后缀，便得到这个名词；其最早记录属中世纪，确切年代不确定。

note.en: The first group gathers forms that echo the word, three from the same Latin capture root and one only resembling it; the second group offers near alternatives for being held in custody.
note.cn: 第一组收外形相近的形式，其中三个同出拉丁「抓取」词根，一个只是形近；第二组是「被关押」这一意思的近义替代。

entries.definition: The building or institution where people are held; it shares the whole history of the longer noun but names the place rather than the penalty.
entries.definitionCN: 关押人的建筑或机构；它与长名词共享整段历史，但指的是场所而非刑罚。

entries.definition: The act of grasping or seizing; it preserves the Latin sense of taking hold that lies behind prison.
entries.definitionCN: 抓取或擒获的动作；它保留了 prison 背后「拿住」的拉丁本义。

entries.definition: To arrest someone or to grasp an idea; built on the same verb of seizing, with a prefix meaning 'towards'.
entries.definitionCN: 逮捕某人或理解某个观念；同建于那个「抓住」的动词，前缀表示「朝向」。

entries.definition: A mark or feeling left by contact; it is merely similar in form and not cognate, being built on a verb meaning 'to press into', not on the verb of seizing.
entries.definitionCN: 接触留下的印记或感觉；只是形近、并非同源，它建于表示「压入」的动词，而不是「抓住」的动词。

entries.definition: Imprisonment in a jail or camp, from Latin carcer 'prison'; it covers the same fact through a completely different word family.
entries.definitionCN: 在监狱或营地中的关押，出自拉丁 carcer「监狱」；它用完全不同的词族说出同一事实。

entries.definition: The state of being kept in custody, often before trial or without a sentence; it stresses withholding rather than punishment.
entries.definitionCN: 被扣留的状态，常在审判前或未判刑时；它强调「留住不放」，而非惩罚。

entries.definition: Being kept within limits or walls; it can apply to a sickroom or a cage, so it is wider and less legal than imprisonment.
entries.definitionCN: 被限制在界限或墙内；它可用于病房或兽笼，因此比 imprisonment 更宽、更少法律色彩。

entries.definition: Responsibility for and control over a person, especially by police or a guardian; it names the keeping, not the sentence.
entries.definitionCN: 对某人的看管与控制，尤指警方或监护人的看管；它指「看住」，不指刑罚。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin capture root, the real related forms and the real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁「抓取」词根、真实的同族形式与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Break it as in- 'into' + prison + -ment 'state', which is exactly how English built the word.
normal.cn: 拆成「进入」加「监狱」加「状态」，这正是英语当初造词的方式。

normal.en: Prison goes back to Latin prehensio 'a seizing', so the word began with a hand closing on a person.
normal.cn: prison 上溯拉丁 prehensio「抓取」，所以这个词最初是一只手把人抓住。

normal.en: Prehendere 'to grasp' also gives apprehend and prehension, all about taking hold.
normal.cn: prehendere「抓住」还给出 apprehend 与 prehension，都与拿住有关。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the legal frame: life imprisonment, a term of imprisonment, imprisonment without trial.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出法律框架：终身监禁、一段刑期、未经审判的关押。

normal.en: The Latin word for a prison building was carcer, a different family, which is why incarceration looks nothing like this word.
normal.cn: 拉丁语中表示监狱建筑的词是 carcer，属另一词族，所以 incarceration 与这个词毫无形似。

abstract.en: Picture a corridor of cells seen from outside, each door locked with the same key.
abstract.cn: 想象从外面看一条牢房走廊，每扇门都用同一把钥匙锁着。

abstract.en: Picture a man's outline left on a street, then a wall drawn where he used to stand.
abstract.cn: 想象街上留下一个人的轮廓，随后在他原来站的地方画起一堵墙。

abstract.en: Picture a clock inside a cell, its hands moving while the room stays still.
abstract.cn: 想象牢房里有一只钟，指针在走，房间却一动不动。

examples.en: He was sentenced to ten years' imprisonment for fraud.
examples.cn: 他因诈骗被判处十年监禁。

examples.en: The charity campaigns against the imprisonment of children.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构致力于反对关押儿童。

examples.en: Her imprisonment in that small town ended when the railway opened.
examples.cn: 铁路开通后，她被困在那座小城的日子结束了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「硬迫人」：硬把一个人迫进铁门里，门从外面锁上，许多年不得出来 → 监禁、关押

root: 拉丁 prehendere「抓住」→ 动作名词 prehensio「抓取、捕获」→ 古法语 prison「扣留；监所」→ 英语 prison；加表「进入」的前缀得 imprison，再加名词后缀得 imprisonment。

sensesIntro.en: The base is a physical fact: a person is taken and placed behind a lock. From that one fact come the court's penalty, the felt condition, the countable term, pre-trial custody, unlawful holding, mass detention, and the deed of putting someone away; only the last two steps leave the walls behind and confine a mind or a life.
sensesIntro.cn: 底层是一个物理事实：人被拿住并放到锁后。由这一个事实生出法庭的刑罚、身处其中的感受、可数的刑期、审判前的羁押、非法的关押、群体性的关押，以及「把人关进去」这一行为；只有最后一步离开实墙，把心智或生活关住。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door locked from the outside, with one person left standing on the inner side of it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇从外面锁上的门，门内只剩一个人站着。

branches.en: THE DEED AND ITS SENTENCE: someone is put away, and the putting away is what the court orders.
branches.cn: 行为与判决：有人被关进去，而「关进去」正是法庭所判之事。

branches.en: INSIDE THE WALL: the same fact felt as a condition, then measured as a span of years.
branches.cn: 墙内的感受：同一事实先被感受为处境，再被量成若干年的跨度。

branches.en: BEFORE JUDGMENT: the lock can close while the case is still open.
branches.cn: 判决之前：案子还没结，锁已经可以先落下。

branches.en: WITHOUT RIGHT, AND IN NUMBERS: captors and camps keep people behind the same kind of door.
branches.cn: 无权与成群：掳掠者与营地用同一类门把人留住，只是没有合法权利、且人数众多。

branches.en: WALLS BECOME CIRCUMSTANCE: the lock turns into a job, a habit or a small town.
branches.cn: 墙化为处境：锁变成一份工作、一种习惯或一座小城。

intro.en: This noun is built from an English prefix, an English noun and a Latin-derived suffix, which makes its structure easy to see.
intro.cn: 这个名词由一个英语前缀、一个英语名词与一个源自拉丁的后缀构成，结构因此很容易看清。

latinIntro.en: The Latin contribution is indirect: the suffix -ment comes from -mentum, and prison itself descends from prehensio, a noun of action from prehendere 'to grasp'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的贡献是间接的：名词后缀出自拉丁语中表动作或结果的词尾，而 prison 本身源自 prehensio，即动词 prehendere「抓住」的动作名词。

definition_zh: 量子力学；描述原子与亚原子尺度物质行为的物理学理论
definition_en: the branch of physics that describes matter and energy at atomic and subatomic scales using discrete states and probabilities
core_image: 一粒电子没有确定的轨道，只有一团浓淡不一的云，云越浓的地方越可能找到它
scene: 黑板上写满波函数与概率，学生算出一个电子最可能出现的位置。 Quantum mechanics predicts where the electron will probably be found.
sceneCN: 这里 quantum mechanics 指「描述原子尺度物质行为的理论」（第 1 个义项：以分立状态与概率描述微观粒子的物理学框架）；句意：量子力学预测这个电子最可能出现在哪里。图中可辨识物件：黑板、波函数曲线、概率云、计算尺。

pos.zh: 量子力学（不可数，作主语时视为单数）

senses.title: The theory of matter at atomic scale
senses.definition: the physical framework that describes how matter and energy behave at atomic and subatomic scales
senses.definitionCN: 描述物质与能量在原子及亚原子尺度上如何行为的物理框架
senses.example: Quantum mechanics explains why atoms emit light at fixed colours.
senses.exampleCN: 量子力学解释了原子为何只发出固定颜色的光。
senses.why: Mechanics names the study of motion, and quantum names the discrete units, so the phrase is 'the mechanics of discrete amounts'.
senses.whyCN: 力学是研究运动的学问，量子指分立单位，因此这个短语就是「分立之量的力学」。

senses.title: The university subject
senses.definition: the course or textbook subject in which the theory is taught
senses.definitionCN: 讲授这套理论的课程或教科书科目
senses.example: She took quantum mechanics in her second year.
senses.exampleCN: 她在第二年修了量子力学。
senses.why: Any named theory becomes a teachable subject, so the phrase also names the timetable slot rather than the physics itself.
senses.whyCN: 任何有名字的理论都会成为可教的科目，因此这个短语也指课程表上的那一格，而非物理本身。

senses.title: The mathematical formalism
senses.definition: the wavefunctions, operators and state spaces used to calculate quantum behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 用来计算量子行为的波函数、算符与状态空间
senses.example: The formalism of quantum mechanics turns observations into operators.
senses.exampleCN: 量子力学的形式体系把观测量变成算符。
senses.why: To be useful, the theory must be written in mathematics, and that machinery is often called by the theory's name.
senses.whyCN: 理论要有用就得写成数学，而这套机器常被直接用理论之名来称呼。

senses.title: Probabilistic prediction
senses.definition: the rule that only the likelihood of a result can be predicted, not the result itself
senses.definitionCN: 只能预测结果的概率、不能预测结果本身的规则
senses.example: Quantum mechanics gives odds, not a single certain path.
senses.exampleCN: 量子力学给出的是几率，而不是唯一确定的路径。
senses.why: The theory's deepest break with classical physics is that it replaces certainty with probability, and that feature is named after it.
senses.whyCN: 这套理论与经典物理最深的决裂，是用概率取代确定性，这一特征便以它命名。

senses.title: The tool for chemistry and materials
senses.titleCN: 用于化学与材料学的工具
senses.definition: the applied use of the theory to explain bonds, spectra and the properties of solids
senses.definitionCN: 把理论用于解释化学键、光谱与固体性质
senses.example: Quantum mechanics now guides the design of new catalysts.
senses.exampleCN: 量子力学如今指导新催化剂的设计。
senses.why: Once the equations could be solved by computer, the theory became an everyday tool in neighbouring sciences.
senses.whyCN: 方程能由计算机求解之后，这套理论就成了邻近学科的日常工具。

senses.title: The classical limit
senses.titleCN: 经典极限：大尺度下退回经典物理
senses.definition: the way quantum rules approach ordinary classical behaviour when objects become large or warm
senses.definitionCN: 当物体变大或变热时，量子规则趋近普通经典行为的方式
senses.example: The correspondence principle shows how quantum mechanics becomes classical mechanics.
senses.exampleCN: 对应原理显示量子力学如何变为经典力学。
senses.why: A theory that governs atoms must still explain why the world looks ordinary, so its own limit became one of its named topics.
senses.whyCN: 管着原子的理论仍须解释世界为何看起来平常，因此它自身的极限成了它的一个专题。

senses.title: Competing interpretations
senses.definition: the rival accounts, such as the Copenhagen view or many worlds, of what the mathematics means
senses.definitionCN: 关于这套数学究竟意味着什么的不同说法，如哥本哈根解释或多世界解释
senses.example: The two camps argue about the interpretation of quantum mechanics, not its predictions.
senses.exampleCN: 两派争论的是量子力学的解释，而不是它的预测。
senses.why: The equations work while their meaning is disputed, so 'interpretation of quantum mechanics' became a field of its own.
senses.whyCN: 方程有效，含义却有争议，于是「量子力学的解释」自成一门学问。

senses.title: The relativistic extension
senses.definition: the version of the theory adjusted for speeds near that of light, leading to quantum field theory
senses.definitionCN: 为接近光速的情况作出调整的版本，进而通向量子场论
senses.example: Relativistic quantum mechanics was needed before antimatter could be predicted.
senses.exampleCN: 必须先有相对论性量子力学，才可能预测反物质。
senses.why: The original theory assumed slow motion, so joining it to relativity became a distinct and named extension.
senses.whyCN: 最初的理论假定运动缓慢，因此把它与相对论结合成一个有专门名称的推广。

intro.en: Quantum mechanics joins Latin quantum 'how much' to mechanics, which comes through Latin mechanica from Greek mēkhanē 'machine, device'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: quantum mechanics 把拉丁语「多少」接到 mechanics 上，而 mechanics 经拉丁 mechanica 出自希腊语「机械、装置」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mēkhanē meant 'a machine, a contrivance, a device for lifting', and mēkhanikos described what belongs to machines.
items.cn: mēkhanē 意为「机械、装置、用来起吊的工具」，mēkhanikos 描述与机械有关之物。

items.en: Latin borrowed mechanica as the name of the science of machines and motion, and English mechanics came through that route.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 mechanica 作为机械与运动之学的名称，英语的 mechanics 经此路径而来。

items.en: Quantum 'how much' entered physics in 1900 as the name of the smallest energy packet, and the adjective sense followed.
items.cn: 表示「多少」的 quantum 在 1900 年作为最小能量包之名进入物理学，其定语用法随后出现。

items.en: In the mid-1920s two formulations, matrix mechanics and wave mechanics, were shown to be one theory, and the joint name quantum mechanics took hold.
items.cn: 二十世纪二十年代中期，矩阵力学与波动力学两种表述被证明是同一理论，「量子力学」这个合名便固定下来。

items.en: Relativistic quantum mechanics and quantum field theory extended the name, while the classical limit kept it tied to ordinary mechanics.
items.cn: 相对论性量子力学与量子场论扩展了这个名称，而经典极限又把它与普通力学连在一起。

items.en: The first written use of the exact English phrase is approximate; both source words are fully attested.
items.cn: 这个英语短语最早的书证年代为约数；两个来源词都有完整记录。

note.en: Group one holds mechanics words built on the same Greek machine-root; group two holds the neighbouring quantum theories it is often confused with.
note.cn: 第一组是同出希腊「机械」词根的力学词；第二组是常与它混淆的邻近量子理论。

entries.definition: The older mechanics of Newton, with definite positions and speeds; it is the limit that quantum mechanics must reproduce.
entries.definitionCN: 牛顿的旧力学，位置与速度皆确定；它是量子力学必须重现的极限。

entries.definition: From the same machine-root but with a result suffix: the working parts of a device or a process, not a mathematical theory.
entries.definitionCN: 同出「机械」词根，但带结果后缀：指装置或过程的运作部件，而非数学理论。

entries.definition: A person who repairs machines, or an adjective meaning mechanical; the plural form alone became the science.
entries.definitionCN: 指修机器的人，或作形容词表示机械的；单是复数形式才成为学科名。

entries.definition: A broader label for the whole framework of discrete physics, of which quantum mechanics is the core calculational part.
entries.definitionCN: 对整个分立物理框架的更宽泛称呼，量子力学是其中核心的计算部分。

entries.definition: The whole branch of physics dealing with quantum effects; quantum mechanics is its main theoretical engine.
entries.definitionCN: 研究量子效应的整个物理学分支；量子力学是其主要理论引擎。

entries.definition: The wave-equation version of quantum mechanics; it is a form of the theory, not a rival to it.
entries.definitionCN: 量子力学的波动方程版本；它是该理论的一种形式，并非其对手。

entries.definition: The framework that combines quantum mechanics with fields and relativity, needed for particles being created and destroyed.
entries.definitionCN: 把量子力学与场、相对论结合起来的框架，用于处理粒子的产生与湮灭。

entries.definition: The mechanics of many particles using ordinary statistics; its probability comes from ignorance, not from nature.
entries.definitionCN: 用普通统计处理大量粒子的力学；其概率来自无知，而非自然本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: quantum 'how much' plus mechanics 'the study of machines and motion': the mechanics of discrete amounts.
normal.cn: 「多少」加「机械与运动之学」：分立之量的力学。

normal.en: The family runs quantum mechanics, quantum-mechanical, matrix mechanics, wave mechanics.
normal.cn: 同族表达包括量子力学、量子力学的、矩阵力学、波动力学。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: foundations of quantum mechanics, laws of quantum mechanics.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：量子力学基础、量子力学定律。

normal.en: Mechanics itself comes from the Greek word for a machine, so the name literally means machine science.
normal.cn: 力学一词本身出自希腊语的「机械」，因此这个名字字面上就是机械之学。

normal.en: The theory's signature is probability: it predicts odds, not single paths.
normal.cn: 这套理论的标志是概率：它预测几率，而非唯一路径。

abstract.en: Picture an electron as a cloud of guesses, thick where the answer is likely.
abstract.cn: 想象电子是一团猜测之云，答案可能的地方云更浓。

abstract.en: Picture a machine that can only be set to fixed gears, never to a smooth in-between speed.
abstract.cn: 想象一台只能挂固定档位、无法无级变速的机器。

abstract.en: Picture a rule book that gives odds for every move instead of one prescribed move.
abstract.cn: 想象一本规则书，为每一步给出几率，而不是规定唯一步法。

examples.en: Quantum mechanics was built to explain the stable colours of heated atoms.
examples.cn: 量子力学是为了解释受热原子稳定的颜色而建立的。

examples.en: The chemistry course assumes no prior study of quantum mechanics.
examples.cn: 这门化学课假定学生此前没有学过量子力学。

examples.en: Engineers use quantum mechanics to predict how a new material will conduct.
examples.cn: 工程师用量子力学预测新材料的导电方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「quantum（量子）+ mechanics（力学）」——管量子那一层的力学，就是量子力学

root: quantum（拉丁「多少」，量子）+ mechanics（拉丁 mechanica，出自希腊 mēkhanē「机械、装置」）。英语 quantum mechanics。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the theory itself to its classroom form, its mathematics, its probability rule, its use in chemistry, its classical limit, its disputed interpretations and its relativistic extension.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从理论本身走到课堂形态、数学形式、概率规则、化学应用、经典极限、有争议的解释，最后是相对论性推广。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloud of probability instead of a fixed orbit, with the densest part marking the likely place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条固定轨道被一团概率云取代，最浓处标出可能出现的位置。

branches.en: THEORY AND TIMETABLE: a framework of physics and a slot in the curriculum are the same name used at two removes.
branches.cn: 理论与课表：物理框架与课程表上的一格，是同一个名字隔了一层的两种用法。

branches.en: THE MACHINERY: wavefunctions and operators are the working parts that make the theory calculable.
branches.cn: 机器：波函数与算符是使理论可计算的运作部件。

branches.en: THE ODDS: certainty is replaced by likelihood, the sharpest break with the older mechanics.
branches.cn: 几率：确定性被可能性取代，这是与旧力学最锋利的决裂。

branches.en: THE TWO DIRECTIONS: the theory reaches into chemistry and materials, and must also explain how ordinary mechanics returns at large scales.
branches.cn: 两个方向：理论伸进化学与材料，也须解释普通力学如何在大尺度上回归。

branches.en: THE UNFINISHED EDGE: meaning is still argued, and the theory must be joined to relativity.
branches.cn: 未完成的边缘：含义仍有争论，理论还须与相对论结合。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin quantity word to a Greek-derived name for the science of machines, so its two halves have separate histories.

definition_zh: 波长；按波长区分的色或波段；看待事物的角度（喻）
definition_en: the distance between one point on a wave and the same point on the next wave, or the band of light that distance identifies
core_image: 池面上一列等距的波纹向前推进，两根标杆量出相邻两个波峰之间的距离
scene: 池面上一列等距的波纹向前推进，测量者量出相邻两个波峰之间的距离。 Each colour of the beam has its own wavelength, and the grating sorts them by that length.
sceneCN: 这里 wavelength 指「相邻两个波峰或波谷之间的距离」（第 1 个义项：波形重复一次所跨越的长度）；句意为光束中每种颜色各有自己的波长，光栅按这个长度把它们分开。可辨识物件：水波、两根标杆、光栅、分色光斑。

pos.zh: 波长；按波长划分的波段；喻指看法、思路

senses.title: Distance between two crests
senses.titleCN: 相邻两个波峰之间的距离
senses.definition: the distance from one crest of a wave to the next crest, or between any two corresponding points in the same phase
senses.definitionCN: 从一个波峰到下一个波峰、或同一相位任意两点之间的距离
senses.example: Each colour of the beam has its own wavelength, and the grating sorts them by that length.
senses.exampleCN: 光束中每种颜色各有自己的波长，光栅按这个长度把它们分开。
senses.why: the word is simply wave plus length: it names the physical length over which the wave repeats itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是「波」加「长度」：它命名的正是波重复一次所跨越的那段长度。

senses.title: The colour a wavelength identifies
senses.titleCN: 由波长确定的那一种颜色或波段
senses.definition: the particular band of visible light that a given wavelength value stands for, such as red or blue
senses.definitionCN: 某个波长数值所代表的可见光波段，如红或蓝
senses.example: A wavelength near four hundred nanometres looks violet to the eye.
senses.exampleCN: 接近四百纳米的波长在眼中呈紫色。
senses.why: once each colour had a number, people began to use the number for the colour, so wavelength came to name the band itself.
senses.whyCN: 每种颜色有了数值之后，人们开始用数值代指颜色，于是 wavelength 也指那一段光本身。

senses.title: Wavelength of a sound wave
senses.definition: the distance between successive compressions or rarefactions in a sound wave, set by speed and pitch
senses.definitionCN: 声波中相邻密部或疏部之间的距离，由声速与音高决定
senses.example: A low note has a longer wavelength than a high note.
senses.exampleCN: 低音的波长比高音更长。
senses.why: the same definition works for any periodic disturbance, so sound inherited the word without any change.
senses.whyCN: 同一定义适用于任何周期性扰动，因此声学原封不动地继承了这个词。

senses.title: A radio band
senses.titleCN: 无线电波段：通信所用的波长范围
senses.definition: a band of radio waves identified by its wavelength, used to separate broadcast and communication channels
senses.definitionCN: 按波长划分的无线电波段，用来区分广播与通信频道
senses.example: The station moved to a longer wavelength to reach the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 这家电台改用更长的波长，以便传到山谷里。
senses.why: early radio engineering tuned by wavelength rather than frequency, and the habit outlived the physics.
senses.whyCN: 早期无线电工程按波长而非频率调谐，这一习惯比其物理依据活得更久。

senses.title: Wavelength inside a medium
senses.titleCN: 介质中的波长：进入玻璃或水后变短
senses.definition: the reduced distance between crests when a wave enters a medium of higher refractive index, while its frequency stays fixed
senses.definitionCN: 波进入折射率更高的介质后波峰间距变短，而频率保持不变
senses.example: Inside the glass the wavelength shrinks, so the glass can hold more crests per metre.
senses.exampleCN: 进入玻璃后波长变短，因此每米能容纳更多波峰。
senses.why: the length is a property of the wave in a place, not an unchangeable label, so physics had to qualify it.
senses.whyCN: 长度是波在某个地点的属性，而非固定标签，因此物理学必须对它加以限定。

senses.title: Wavelength of a matter wave
senses.titleCN: 物质波波长：电子等粒子对应的波
senses.definition: the wavelength associated with a particle such as an electron, set by its momentum
senses.definitionCN: 电子等粒子所对应的波长，由其动量决定
senses.example: The electron wavelength is short enough to resolve a crystal lattice.
senses.exampleCN: 电子的波长足够短，可以分辨晶格。
senses.why: quantum theory extended the word from waves of light to waves of probability attached to particles.
senses.whyCN: 量子理论把这个词从光波扩展到附着于粒子的概率波。

senses.title: Being on the same wavelength
senses.titleCN: 喻指想法一致、心意相通
senses.definition: sharing the same way of thinking so that two people understand each other easily
senses.definitionCN: 持有相同的思路，因而彼此容易理解
senses.example: The two engineers were on the same wavelength from the first meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 两位工程师从第一次会面起就想法一致。
senses.why: two waves reinforce only when their crests match, and that physical agreement became a figure for mental agreement.
senses.whyCN: 两列波只有波峰对齐才会叠加增强，这种物理上的契合被用来比喻心思相合。

senses.title: Abstract: the scale on which things differ
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：衡量事物差异的尺度
senses.definition: a scale or dimension along which otherwise similar things can be compared
senses.definitionCN: 在某个维度上比较原本相似之物的尺度
senses.example: The two policies differ only in wavelength, not in kind.
senses.exampleCN: 这两项政策只在尺度上不同，性质上并无差别。
senses.why: the abstract sense keeps only the measuring function: wavelength is whatever scale makes the difference visible.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义只保留测量功能：波长成了那个能让差异显形的尺度。

intro.en: Wavelength is an English compound of wave and length, coined when wave optics needed a name for the distance between crests. The exact first use is not settled.
intro.cn: wavelength 是 wave 与 length 的英语复合词，在波动光学需要为相邻波峰之间的距离命名时出现，确切首见年代并无定论。

items.en: Wave named the moving ridge on water long before physics used it; its deeper origin is uncertain.
items.cn: wave 在物理学使用它之前很久就指水面移动的波脊；其更早来源不确定。

items.en: Length comes from Old English lengthu, a native noun built on lang, long.
items.cn: length 出自古英语 lengthu，是本族名词，由 lang「长」构成。

items.en: Wave and length were joined once interference experiments made the spacing between crests measurable; early texts often wrote it as two words.
items.cn: 当干涉实验使波峰间距可以测量时，wave 与 length 被合在一起；早期文本常分写作两个词。

items.en: The compound then covered water waves, sound and light alike, because each repeats over a fixed distance.
items.cn: 此后这一复合词同时涵盖水波、声波与光，因为三者都在固定距离上重复。

items.en: In the twentieth century on the same wavelength turned the physical match into a figure for mutual understanding.
items.cn: 20 世纪，「波长相同」这一说法把物理上的对齐转为彼此理解的比喻。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): the first printed use is not agreed, nor whether it was written wave length or wavelength; the deeper origin of wave is likewise unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：最早印刷用例没有定论，也无法确认当时写作 wave length 还是 wavelength；wave 的更深来源同样没有定论。

note.en: Group one holds compounds that begin with wave but name different quantities; group two holds the quantities that wavelength is measured against.
note.cn: 第一组是以 wave 开头、却指不同量的复合词；第二组是与波长相互换算或对照的量。

entries.definition: The number of waves per unit length, the inverse of wavelength; a spectroscopist favourite.
entries.definitionCN: 单位长度内的波数，是波长的倒数；光谱学家常用。

entries.definition: The surface over which all points share the same phase; it marks a position, not a distance.
entries.definitionCN: 所有点相位相同的那个面；它标出位置，而不是距离。

entries.definition: A brief localized oscillation used in signal analysis; its length is not the same as its duration.
entries.definitionCN: 信号分析中短暂而局部的一段振荡；其长度与持续时间并非同一件事。

entries.definition: A tube or channel that confines and directs waves; it carries them rather than measuring them.
entries.definitionCN: 约束并引导波的管子或通道；它传输波，而不测量波。

entries.definition: The number of cycles per second; for any fixed speed, frequency and wavelength are inversely related.
entries.definitionCN: 每秒的周期数；在速度固定时，频率与波长成反比。

entries.definition: The maximum displacement of a wave, which sets its intensity rather than its spacing.
entries.definitionCN: 波的最大位移，决定强度而不是间距。

entries.definition: The time one full cycle takes; it is the time-domain partner of wavelength.
entries.definitionCN: 完成一个完整周期所需的时间；是波长在时间上的对应量。

entries.definition: A group of wavelengths treated together; wavelength is a single value, a band is a range.
entries.definitionCN: 被当作一组处理的一段波长；波长是单个值，band 是一段范围。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two real English halves, the real inverse relation with frequency, and the real fixed phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个真实的英语成分、与频率之间真实的倒数关系，以及真实的固定短语。

normal.en: Wave plus length: the length one wave occupies before it repeats.
normal.cn: 「波」加「长度」：一列波重复之前所占据的长度。

normal.en: Wavelength and frequency move in opposite directions when speed is fixed.
normal.cn: 速度固定时，波长与频率朝相反方向变化。

normal.en: The plural is wavelengths, and old texts wrote wave length as two words.
normal.cn: 复数形式加 -s，旧文本曾把「波」与「长度」分作两词。

normal.en: The everyday figure is on the same wavelength, meaning thinking alike.
normal.cn: 日常比喻是「波长相同」，意为想法一致。

normal.en: Radio engineers once tuned by wavelength and still speak of long and short wave.
normal.cn: 无线电工程师曾按波长调谐，如今仍说长波与短波。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid along a row of identical hilltops.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺子沿一排相同的山顶铺开。

abstract.en: Picture two radio dials that must point to the same mark before a call connects.
abstract.cn: 想象两只收音刻度盘必须指到同一格，通话才接得通。

abstract.en: Picture two friends walking in step without having to say so.
abstract.cn: 想象两位朋友不用开口就同步迈步。

examples.en: The laser emits at a wavelength of six hundred and thirty nanometres.
examples.cn: 这台激光器在六百三十纳米的波长上发射。

examples.en: Longer wavelengths travel farther around obstacles but carry less detail.
examples.cn: 更长的波长能绕过障碍传得更远，但携带的细节更少。

examples.en: The two managers were finally on the same wavelength about the budget.
examples.cn: 两位经理在预算问题上终于想法一致了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「wave（波）+ length（长度）」——一列波的长度 → 波长；两个人「长度相同」→ 想法一致

root: 英语本族复合词：wave（古英语，指波浪，更早来源不确定）+ length（古英语 lengthu，出自 lang「长」）。无拉丁同族，故本词条不列拉丁借词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with the measured distance, then move to the colour it names, to sound waves, radio bands, waves inside glass and matter waves, and finally to two figurative scales.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项以可测量的距离开始，随后移到它所代表的颜色、声波、无线电波段、玻璃中的波与物质波，最后落在两种比喻性的尺度上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ruler laid between two crests of the same repeating wave.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把尺子铺在同一列重复波的相邻两个波峰之间。

branches.en: PHYSICAL LENGTH: the literal repetition distance is the root of every other sense.
branches.cn: 物理长度：字面的重复距离，是其余一切义项的根。

branches.en: COLOUR AS NUMBER: a value becomes the name of a visible band.
branches.cn: 以数代色：一个数值变成了某段可见光的名字。

branches.en: OTHER WAVES: sound and radio inherit the same spacing, though engineers tuned by it rather than measured it.
branches.cn: 别的波：声与无线电继承同一种间距，只是工程师按它调谐而非测量它。

branches.en: CONTEXT AND QUANTUM: a medium shortens the length, and matter itself acquires one.
branches.cn: 介质与量子：介质使长度变短，物质本身也获得了波长。

branches.en: ALIGNMENT AND SCALE: matching crests becomes matching minds, and any dimension of difference becomes a scale.
branches.cn: 对齐与尺度：波峰相合变成心思相合，任何差异维度都成了一个尺度。

intro.en: Wavelength is not a Latin derivative but a native English compound, so it is best read as two free morphemes rather than as prefix plus root.
intro.cn: wavelength 不是拉丁派生词，而是英语本族复合词，因此更适合按两个自由语素来读，而不是按前缀加词根来读。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root behind this word: wave and length are both native English nouns, so no Latin borrowing stands behind it; the Greek or Latin quotations sometimes offered for them are cognates, not ancestors.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词背后没有拉丁词根：wave 与 length 都是英语本族名词，没有拉丁借词为其源头；有时为它们给出的希腊或拉丁形式只是同源词，并非祖先。

definition_zh: v. 停止；中断；不再继续；停产；停供
definition_en: to stop doing, making or providing something that had been continuing
core_image: 一条一直往前走的传送带被一只手按下停止键，后面的货不再出来
scene: 厂家去年停产了这个型号。 The maker discontinued the model last year.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：厂家不再生产某个型号，产品线到此为止。

senses.title: Stop an activity
senses.definition: to stop doing something that you had been doing regularly
senses.definitionCN: （动词）停止原本一直在做的某件事
senses.example: She discontinued the treatment after six weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 六周之后她停止了治疗。
senses.why: A prescription pad with the last line crossed out.
senses.whyCN: 处方笺上最后一行被划掉。

senses.title: Stop making or supplying
senses.definition: to stop producing or providing a product or service
senses.definitionCN: （动词）不再生产或提供某种产品或服务
senses.example: The factory discontinued the model last year.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂去年停产了这个型号。
senses.why: A shop shelf where one product never comes back.
senses.whyCN: 商店货架上某样产品再也不补货。

senses.title: Break the continuity
senses.definition: to interrupt a continuous line, series or process
senses.definitionCN: （动词）打断一条连续的线、序列或过程
senses.example: The fence was discontinued where the path crossed.
senses.exampleCN: 围栏在小路穿过的地方中断了。
senses.why: A fence with a gap where a path crosses it.
senses.whyCN: 围栏在小路穿过处留出一个缺口。

intro.en: Discontinue is dis- plus continue; continue goes back through Old French continuer to Latin continuare, to make unbroken, from continuus and the root tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: discontinue 由 dis-（离开、否定）加 continue（继续）构成；continue 经古法语 continuer 上溯拉丁语 continuare「使连接不断」，来自 continuus，最深的词根是 tenere「握住、保持」。

items.en: Latin tenere means to hold or keep.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tenere 意为握住、保持。

items.en: From con- plus tenere came continuus, unbroken.
items.cn: 由 con- 加 tenere 得到 continuus，意为不间断的。

items.en: Continuare meant to join things without a break.
items.cn: continuare 意为把东西连接起来不留断口。

items.en: Old French continuer carried the sense of keeping on.
items.cn: 古法语 continuer 承接了继续下去的意思。

items.en: Middle English contynuen entered the language as continue.
items.cn: 中古英语 contynuen 进入英语成为 continue。

items.en: The prefix dis- was added to give discontinue, to stop keeping on.
items.cn: 加上前缀 dis- 得到 discontinue，意为不再继续。

note.en: Discontinue is continue with a negative prefix; its neighbours either keep the same root or mean stopping.
note.cn: discontinue 是 continue 加否定前缀；它的邻居要么同词根，要么表示停止。

dict_mnemonic.text: discontinue ＝ dis-（离开、否定）＋ continue（继续）＝不再继续，「停止、中断」；continue 的词根是拉丁语 tenere「握住」，握住不放就是连续，松手就是 discontinue。

root: 拉丁语 tenere（握住）→ continuus（不间断的）→ continuare（使连续）→ 古法语 continuer → 英语 continue → 加 dis- 成 discontinue

sensesIntro.en: One stopping hand: an activity called off, a product line cut and a fence left with a gap.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一只叫停的手：一项活动被中止、一条产品线被剪断、一段围栏留下缺口。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pressing stop on a conveyor belt that had been running without a break
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手按下原本不停运转的传送带的停止键

branches.en: A treatment stopped after six weeks.
branches.cn: 六周之后停止的治疗。

branches.en: A model no longer made after last year.
branches.cn: 去年之后不再生产的型号。

branches.en: A fence with a gap where the path crosses.
branches.cn: 小路穿过处留有缺口的围栏。

branches.en: Both cut something that used to run on.
branches.cn: 两者都剪断了原本持续的东西。

branches.en: Both leave a place where nothing follows.
branches.cn: 两者都留下一个后面接不上的位置。

intro.en: Discontinue is dis- plus continue; the hold root also builds continuous, continuity and contain.
intro.cn: discontinue 由 dis- 加 continue 构成；握住这个词根也造出 continuous、continuity 与 contain。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere means to hold, continuus unbroken and continuare to make continuous.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tenere 意为握住，continuus 意为不间断的，continuare 意为使连续。
